amount_max.description:
An item of at most this amount, US dollars.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

amount_min.description:
An item of at least this amount, US dollars.

contribution_date_after.description: An item dated on or after this date. Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

contribution_date_before.description: An item dated on or before this date. Pattern: ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$.

Item type: feca (FECA contribution), he (honorary expenses), me (meeting expenses), ple (presidential library), pic (presidential inaugural committee).

MM mid-year, MA mid-year amendment, YY year-end, YA year-end amendment.

filing_year.description:
